run_route.instruction: Connect a CPU. Run the whole setup cell once and wait for Ready.
run_route.expected: Ready appears; the support files and CPU packages are available.

run_route.instruction: Run L0 with RUN_OPENDSS=False and RUN_LOCAL_LLAMA=False.
run_route.expected: The data assertion passes. Both optional live-tool paths remain off.

run_route.instruction: Run the whole L1 cell after L0.
run_route.expected: binding_pass is True, False, False in row order.

run_route.instruction: Run the full L2 cell at LOAD_SCALE=1.0 and RATING_FRACTION=0.80.
run_route.expected: Both default proposals pass; current use is about 73.62% for MPC and 51.68% for SAC.

run_route.instruction: Change only RATING_FRACTION to 0.75. Predict, then rerun all of L2. Give this exercise four minutes.
run_route.expected: MPC current use is about 78.53%; SAC about 54.85%; both pass this MV test.

run_route.instruction: Restore LOAD_SCALE=1.0 and RATING_FRACTION=0.80; rerun the complete L2 cell.
run_route.expected: The default output returns. L3-L5 will use their separate original test_01 case.

run_route.instruction: Run L3. Keep the default test_01 case.
run_route.expected: Three saved model replies and recorded times appear; no new model request occurs.

run_route.instruction: Run L4 after L3 without changing the case ID.
run_route.expected: Both selectors choose RELAX_Q_10_PERCENT. Both new electrical checks pass.

run_route.instruction: Run L5 with RUN_OPENDSS still False.
run_route.expected: The linear-model check is shown; the optional full-model path is disabled.
The priority MILP agrees with exhaustive enumeration. At 40 kW, compare 130/90 with 140/30 kW total/critical.

run_route.instruction: Append 180. to CAPACITIES_KW, keeping 40. first. Rerun all of L6. Give this exercise four minutes.
run_route.expected: At 180 kW, both goals serve 250 kW total and 90 kW critical.

run_route.instruction: Restore the original capacity list and rerun L6. Then run the whole L7 cell.
run_route.expected: Original contract: True. Changed rating with old evidence: False. HOLD requests a fresh solve.
A coordinated Hc attack preserves a small residual while offline state error grows.

run_route.instruction: Add .10 to ATTACK_SCALES. Rerun all of L8 and inspect the isolated-bias row. Give this exercise four minutes.
run_route.expected: At isolated scale 0.10, J is about 10.14, below the 15.09 threshold; no alarm is not proof of truth.

run_route.instruction: Restore ATTACK_SCALES=(0.,.25,.5,1.,1.5) and rerun all of L8.
run_route.expected: The default sweep returns. L9 remains a separate fixed recovery fixture.

run_route.instruction: Run all of L9 after resetting L8.
run_route.expected: No trusted replacement readings: HOLD. With assumed trusted readings: PROPOSE, u about 0.121694 p.u., zero offline violations.

run_route.instruction: Run all of L10 after L9. Read the case and stage columns in the saved trace.
run_route.expected: Five stage names appear. Planning and optimizer rows contain actual saved Llama replies; other stages contain Python results.

run_route.instruction: After L10, run the whole L10B cell for SCENARIO="voltage", then "restoration", then "cyber". Change only that string between runs.
run_route.expected: Input, exact model choice and public reason, saved tool result and next step appear. No new LLM call or electrical solve runs.

run_route.instruction: Keep RUN_LOCAL_LLAMA=False. Run L11 and expect SKIPPED. Then run all of L12.
run_route.expected: The table shows HOLD for full MV/LV and an acknowledged MV teaching request. The assertions confirm wrong-ID rejection; equipment_dispatch remains False.
